name: Steels & Ferrous Alloys
summary: Covers the metallurgy of iron and steel, the world's most important structural material, from phase transformations to alloy families.

Plain-carbon and low-alloy steels; AISI/SAE designations
High-strength low-alloy (HSLA) and microalloyed steels; thermomechanical processing
